title: Half Adder and Full Adder
aim: To design and realize Half Adder and Full Adder combinational circuits using basic logic gates.

theory.summary: An adder is a digital circuit that performs addition of numbers. A Half Adder adds two binary inputs A and B to output Sum (A ⊕ B) and Carry (A · B). A Full Adder adds three inputs A, B, and Cin to output Sum (A ⊕ B ⊕ Cin) and Carry (A·B + Cin·(A ⊕ B)).

procedure: Step 1: Mount the ICs on the breadboard. Connect VCC (pin 14) and GND (pin 7) for all ICs.
Step 2: Connect XOR gate inputs to logic toggles A and B. Connect XOR output to Sum LED.
Step 3: Connect AND gate inputs to logic toggles A and B. Connect AND output to Carry LED. Verify Half Adder truth table.
Step 4: Cascade XOR and AND gates to build the Full Adder according to logic diagram. Verify outputs for all 8 input combinations.

observations.what_to_plot: Verify and tabulate digital truth table output values.

expected_results.description: Truth tables of Half Adder and Full Adder should match logic configurations. Sum should be high when odd numbers of inputs are high.

causes: IC power lines VCC/GND are not connected
common_errors.fix: Always remember to hook up Pin 14 of TTL ICs to 5V and Pin 7 to Ground.

viva_questions.q: Can you design a Full Adder using two Half Adders?
viva_questions.a: Yes, by connecting the sum output of the first Half Adder to the input of the second, and ORing the carry outputs of both Half Adders.
